note: Het enige model van ModernoMilano. Elke foto en video met een persoon gebruikt deze man, nooit een andere en nooit twee. Bron van waarheid voor de engine (src/creative/casting.ts), de Python-builders en de creative-engine skill. Uitleg: creative-engine/brand/model.md.
name: Luca

face_refs.view: vooraanzicht, zittend op een dak in Milaan
close-up, driekwart, Navigli (haar hier anders gekamd)
van achteren/opzij, kijkt omlaag; ware haarkleur

prompt.identity_en: a man in his mid-twenties with dark chestnut-brown hair, long and full on top, combed up and back from a soft break on his right so a soft wave falls over his left temple, the sides swept back over the tops of his ears; thick, dark, nearly straight brows set low over deep-set hazel-brown eyes; a rectangular face with defined cheekbones, a broad jaw with sharp angles below the ears and a broad squared chin; a straight nose with a rounded tip; full lips, the lower lip fuller and slightly forward; a faint stubble shadow; light warm skin; a long neck, broad relaxed shoulders and an athletic build
prompt.keep_en: He is exactly the man in the reference images: keep his face, brows, eyes, jaw, lips, hair colour, hair length and the way his hair is combed; do not make him older, narrow his jaw, arch his brows, change his hair colour or smooth his skin. He does not resemble any actor or public figure.
must_not_en: no beard, goatee or moustache; never more than light stubble
not older than about thirty; no grey hair
no narrow V-shaped jaw or pointed chin
no blond, red or black hair; no fade, undercut, wet-look gel or centre-parted curtains
no toothy grin and no forced smoulder
never a different man, and never two men in one picture
prompt.realism_en: An unretouched photograph. Natural healthy skin with fine real texture and a faint stubble shadow, matte, with no beauty glow, no airbrushing and no painted-on pores or spots. The clothes are real fabric with visible knit stitch and soft creases at the elbows and waist. Real optics: full-frame digital camera, shallow depth of field, slight lens softness at the edges. No film borders, no frame, no text, no logos.
prompt.light_default_en: One motivated light source: the low sun behind him to one side puts a warm rim on his hair and shoulder while his face sits in soft open shade; the background is a stop darker and out of focus; muted warm colour, lifted blacks, soft contrast; no HDR, no teal-and-orange grade.
prompt.expression_en: a calm, closed-mouth expression, eyes off camera, caught between moments; at most a faint closed-mouth smile
prompt.framing_en: waist-up or three-quarter by default, off-centre, seen from the side, over the shoulder or from behind, with something soft in the foreground; full length at most two in ten pictures
prompt.public_places_en: two or three distant passers-by, small and out of focus, faces unreadable; any shop signs far away and too blurred to read

rules.image_model_with_products: nano_banana_pro, resolution 4k, aspect 4:5, element placeholder in the prompt, product photos as image_references (max 4 per shot)
rules.image_model_portrait: soul_2 with soul_id, quality 2k, aspect 3:4 (crop to 4:5), max 1 product image
rules.video: image-to-video from an approved still: seedance_2_0, 5 s, 1080p, start_image = approved still job_id, element placeholder in the prompt; small natural movement, no full head turns
rules.qa: Every picture with a face next to the reference images: is it the same man? If not, reject it.
